candidate.scope: Illumina schematic of precision nuclear run-on sequencing (PRO-seq), specifically four separate reactions each supplied with one biotin-NTP species, followed independently through the depicted preparation to cDNA for each nucleotide. The four branches are repeated instances of one assay, not four methods, and no pooling is depicted. The matching RNA collection page 38 explicitly captions this figure as PRO-seq. PRO-cap and GRO-seq are contextual comparisons in the descriptions, not targets or alternative routes drawn here. The card also describes other PRO-seq nucleotide mixtures; those unshown implementations are not substituted for this four-reaction drawing. The left Pol II, template/chromatin and nascent-RNA icons establish starting biological context, not separate preparation operations. The diagram inventories a run-on, extraction/hydrolysis, three streptavidin captures, two intervening Purify steps, 3-prime adapter addition, end repair/5-prime adapter addition, and a combined reverse-transcription/amplification block. Sequencing is the supported downstream interface, not an added depicted operation.
